apps/packages/product-client/src/compone.justification: Pre-existing: the diff card header is a whole-row expand affordance wrapping its own interactive children; a Button wrapper would nest interactive elements. Migration is the git-review conformance slice, not this gate.
Pre-existing: collapsed-hunk expander built as a div so the expanded body can replace it in place. Recorded in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md Current Gaps as one of the shells predating the rule.
Playground prototype surface: it exists to try shapes before they are sanctioned, so it is exempt from the call-site rule and carries the same exemption here.

Recorded exemption already written at the site: no sanctioned overlay path owns a listbox anchored by normal document flow (PopoverButton/DropdownMenu/Tooltip are all popper-positioned and portalled).
Pre-existing: the PRO-120 tool-call row must not paint Button's pressed rectangle; the quiet-row state trade is recorded on the row and its replacement waits on a suppressible interactive primitive.
Pre-existing: a hover card positioned from measured tab geometry, not from Tooltip's popper. Deferred overlay shell named in Current Gaps.

apps/packages/product-client/src/primiti.justification: Library-owned: the command palette IS the sanctioned dialog shape for cmdk, built on the vendor primitive rather than on ModalShell by design.
Library-owned recorded trade: the roster row renders a div with role=button so its trailing action buttons can nest without an invalid button-in-button.
Library-owned recorded trade: the sidebar row surface hosts nested action buttons, so the row itself carries role=button on a div rather than being a <button>.

apps/packages/product-client/src/compone.justification: Pre-existing sanctioned component with no JSDoc; the index row carries its contract today. Backfill is documentation debt, and this allowance only shrinks.
